import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { z as z3 } from 'zod/v3';
import {
  CMS_DELIVERY_CONTRACT,
  CmsDeliveryDirectoryPayloadSchema,
  CmsDeliveryEntrySchema,
  CmsDeliveryErrorResponseSchema,
  CmsDeliveryListResponseSchema,
  createValidationErrorResponse,
  formatZodError,
  type ApiSuccess,
  type CmsDeliveryActionKey,
  type CmsDeliveryDirectoryPayload,
  type CmsDeliveryDirectoryOptions,
  type CmsDeliveryListItem,
  type CmsDeliveryListResult,
} from './package/index';

type Assert<T extends true> = T;
type IsAny<T> = 0 extends (1 & T) ? true : false;
export type ConsumerTypeChecks = [
  Assert<IsAny<CmsDeliveryDirectoryPayload> extends false ? true : false>,
  Assert<IsAny<CmsDeliveryDirectoryOptions> extends false ? true : false>,
  Assert<IsAny<CmsDeliveryDirectoryOptions['fields'][number]> extends false ? true : false>,
  Assert<Extract<keyof CmsDeliveryListItem, 'body' | 'createdBy' | 'data'> extends never ? true : false>,
  Assert<CmsDeliveryActionKey extends 'cms.delivery.listByDirectory' | 'cms.delivery.getById' ? true : false>,
];
const directoryId = '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222';
const entryId = '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111';
const input: CmsDeliveryDirectoryPayload = { directoryId, fields: 'title' };
const parsed: CmsDeliveryDirectoryOptions = CmsDeliveryDirectoryPayloadSchema.parse(input);
const limit: number = parsed.limit;
assert.equal(limit, 20);
assert.deepEqual(parsed.fields, ['id', 'title']);
assert.equal(CMS_DELIVERY_CONTRACT.publication, 'snapshot');
assert.deepEqual(z3.object({ entry: CmsDeliveryEntrySchema }).parse({ entry: { id: entryId } }), { entry: { id: entryId } });

const response: ApiSuccess<CmsDeliveryListResult> = CmsDeliveryListResponseSchema.parse({
  ok: true, data: { items: [{ id: entryId }], page: { limit: 20, offset: 0, hasMore: false } },
});
assert.equal(response.data.items[0].id, entryId);
assert.deepEqual(CmsDeliveryEntrySchema.parse({ id: entryId, body: { values: [null, true, 1] } }).body, { values: [null, true, 1] });
assert.equal(CmsDeliveryDirectoryPayloadSchema.safeParse({ directoryId, fields: 'createdBy' }).success, false);

// Delivery errors must work with the package's existing envelope helpers.
const invalidDelivery = CmsDeliveryDirectoryPayloadSchema.safeParse({ directoryId, limit: 0 });
assert.equal(invalidDelivery.success, false);
if (!invalidDelivery.success) {
  const error = createValidationErrorResponse(invalidDelivery.error, 'fixture-request');
  assert.deepEqual(CmsDeliveryErrorResponseSchema.parse(error), error);
  assert.equal(error.error.code, 'VALIDATION_ERROR');
  assert.deepEqual(error.error.details?.issues?.[0].path, ['limit']);
}
const unavailable = { ok: false, error: {
  code: CMS_DELIVERY_CONTRACT.errors.unavailable.code,
  message: CMS_DELIVERY_CONTRACT.errors.unavailable.message,
} };
assert.deepEqual(CmsDeliveryErrorResponseSchema.parse(unavailable), unavailable);
assert.equal(CmsDeliveryErrorResponseSchema.safeParse({
  ...unavailable, error: { ...unavailable.error, details: {} },
}).success, false);
// Existing users may also pass errors from their installed root Zod version.
const invalidUser = z.object({ title: z.string().min(1) }).safeParse({ title: '' });
assert.equal(invalidUser.success, false);
if (!invalidUser.success) {
  assert.deepEqual(formatZodError(invalidUser.error).issues?.[0].path, ['title']);
  assert.equal(createValidationErrorResponse(invalidUser.error).error.code, 'VALIDATION_ERROR');
}
